title: Code and data for "Hilbert functions of filtered graphical zonotopal algebras"
description: Programs and recorded output behind the computer-assisted statements of the paper "Hilbert functions of filtered graphical zonotopal algebras" by B. Shapiro, I. Smirnov and A. Vaintrob: exact parameter certificates, exhaustive searches over small trees and unicyclic graphs, the tables of Hilbert functions of small graphs, the cycle series for n up to 17, and the certificate for the low-degree conjecture on graphs with at most seven vertices.
